instruction: Find the area 5 km south of Portland.
note: Ambiguous: Portland OR vs Portland ME. Should default to the larger city (Oregon).

instruction: Locate the midpoint between Cambridge in England and Cambridge in Massachusetts.
note: Same name, different countries. Both must be correctly disambiguated.

instruction: 3 km at a bearing of 10 degrees west of south from the Sydney Opera House.
note: Compound direction: '10 degrees west of south' = 180+10 = 190 degrees.

instruction: Find a location 0.5 km north of Big Ben in London.
note: Very short distance — tests precision at small scale.

instruction: Find the midpoint between the North Pole and the South Pole.
note: Extreme geographic scale — result should be on the equator.

instruction: 200 km east of Honolulu, Hawaii, in the Pacific Ocean.
note: Result is in open ocean — no landmass. Tests that system handles water locations.

instruction: 1 км к северу от деревни Лесхоз в Татарстане, Россия.
note: Obscure Russian village. Tests Cyrillic geocoding with LLM enrichment.

instruction: Find the area in the center of the triangle formed by Paris, London, and Brussels.
note: Centroid of a triangle — requires creative function composition.

instruction: 500 meters south of the White House, Washington DC.
note: Distance in meters, not km — tests unit handling.

instruction: Go 15 km northwest from the place that is 10 km east of the Kremlin.
note: Nested relative reference — the starting point itself is defined relatively.
